name: Thunder Falls
summary: Bandits now hold a cottage beside the stream at Thunder Falls, high in northwestern Elwynn Forest.

sections.title: A Hidden Mountain Hollow
sections.body:
Above Mirror Lake, a mountain stream runs between the steep cliffs of Thunder Falls. From an unreachable cascade in the north, it spills down in falls on both sides. One pours into Mirror Lake, while the stream runs west toward Westfall’s rugged border.

A cottage, a dock, and an outdoor forge stand beside the water. Bandits now claim the clearing.

faq.q: How do you reach Thunder Falls?
aliases: how to get to thunder falls
faq.answer: From the northern side of Mirror Lake, a steep, narrow trail climbs into the hills beside the waterfall’s right side. Follow it into the ravine.

faq.q: Who lives in the cottage at Thunder Falls?
faq.answer: The cottage appears to have belonged to a solitary fisherman or frontiersman. A dock, rowing boat, and outdoor anvil remain nearby, but bandits operating in Elwynn Forest now use the cottage as a remote hideout.

faq.q: Where does the river at Thunder Falls flow?
faq.answer: The stream runs through a narrow mountain gap from an upper cascade. It passes the cottage, then plunges down a steep waterfall near Westfall’s eastern boundary.
